title: Volterra Generative Models via Markovian Lifting
abstract: arXiv:2606.18071v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion-based generative models usually perturb data through Markov processes driven by Brownian motion. Volterra processes allow more flexible temporal dependence, but their non-Markovian structure complicates score learning and reverse-time simulation. We develop Volterra generative models and provide Markovian approximations. Gaussian conditioning then reduces the denoising problem to the original data dimension. We present the connections with variance-exploding and variance-preserving representations. Our framework also permits reuse of pretrained denoisers such as EDM2 networks. With one auxiliary factor, our models trained from scratch achieve FIDs of $0.547$ on MNIST and $1.860$ on conditional CIFAR-10. With autoguidance, ImageNet64 FID reaches $1.912$ after fine-tuning, while ImageNet512 FID reaches $1.903$ using frozen pretrained networks.

translated_title: 基于马尔可夫提升的Volterra生成模型
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的生成模型通常通过由布朗运动驱动的马尔可夫过程来扰动数据。Volterra过程允许更灵活的时间依赖结构，但其非马尔可夫特性使得得分学习和反向时间模拟变得复杂。我们开发了Volterra生成模型并提供了马尔可夫近似方法。借助高斯条件化，去噪问题被简化到原始数据维度。我们还阐明了该框架与方差爆炸和方差保持表示之间的联系。此外，我们的框架支持重用预训练的去噪器，例如EDM2网络。借助一个辅助因子，我们从头训练的模型在MNIST上取得了0.547的FID，在条件CIFAR-10上取得了1.860的FID。通过自动引导，ImageNet64在微调后FID达到1.912，而ImageNet512使用冻结的预训练网络FID达到1.903。
tldr: 本文提出通过马尔可夫提升方法构建Volterra生成模型，将非马尔可夫的Volterra过程转化为可处理的马尔可夫近似，从而支持重用预训练去噪器，并在MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet基准上取得了优异的FID性能。
en_tdlr: This paper develops Volterra generative models through Markovian lifting, approximating non-Markovian Volterra processes to enable reuse of pretrained denoisers and achieve strong FID performance on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet benchmarks.
